buyBody: A mallet cover in signature white and gold, in right and left hand. Mallet heads are wide and awkward and most covers do not fit them properly, which is the entire reason this one exists separately from the blade.

four.v: It knows which hand you play
Ships in one to two days

details.headline: A mallet is the worst-shaped thing in your bag
paras: Wide, flat and heavy, so it finds every other club on the way in and out. The head is also the part your playing partners look at eighteen times a round.
Nobody enjoys buying a head cover. Buy it anyway and the putter still looks like the photos in a year.

details.headline: Mallets, in either hand
paras: Cut for a mallet head — the Tracer LGP02, and most other mallets. Pick the hand you actually play; a mallet cover is not symmetrical and the wrong one will not sit right.
Playing a blade? The Lucky Blade Cover is the shape you want.
